HoldMyTrack reads your recorded exercise sessions and their GPS routes from Health Connect, and adds the outdoor ones to your map. It reads nothing else — no heart rate, no weight, no sleep — and it never writes anything back. Sessions recorded indoors have no route, so they are skipped.
Sign in to HoldMyTrack first — there is nowhere to sync to until then.
Confirm your email address first — open HoldMyTrack if you need a new confirmation link.
The demo account is read-only — it can\'t add, edit, or delete activities. Create an account to sync your own data.
Health Connect isn\'t available on this device, so there is nothing to sync from.

HoldMyTrack can\'t read your exercise sessions yet.

HoldMyTrack can read your sessions, but not their routes — and a session without a route has nothing to draw on the map. This one has to be granted inside Health Connect; it can\'t be requested from here.

The button below opens Health Connect. Android only lets an app open its home screen, so from there:

1. Tap App permissions
2. Choose HoldMyTrack
3. Scroll down to Additional access
4. Tap Access exercise routes
5. Choose Always allow

Then come back here.
